text:
maya_support: Heads up — multiple customers reporting $0 / NaN in the Cost Matrix token column after the analytics rewrite deploy (~12:30 UTC). Screenshots attached, one org id: org_99012. Affects ~13 orgs across EU/US. Escalating to eng-sre + analytics.

deploy-bot: deployed analytics-rollup-service v2.0.3 by javier at 2026-03-17T12:28:46Z :rocket:

javier: looking — thanks for the ping. any sample org ids + console query that reproduces?

maya_support: reproducible on org_99012, org_4471, org_8819. Quick repro SQL (from console query tool):

```sql
SELECT org_id, sum(tokens * price_per_token) as total_cost
FROM token_usage u
LEFT JOIN model_price p ON u.model_price_key = p.price_key
WHERE org_id = 'org_99012'
GROUP BY org_id;
```

Result shows total_cost = 0 or NaN for some rows. When I inspect `p.price_key` it looks NULL for certain models. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/anon/snap1.png

eli_analytics: can confirm I see the same in my dev cluster when I run the rollup with the new code path. The price lookup table got rekeyed in v2.0.3 — price_key is now stored as a string prefixed with `mp:` for some rows. The usage side still emits a numeric key. Join mismatch => NULL prices => downstream sum becomes 0/NaN depending on cast.

meera_cs: hitters are customer-visible — several users emailed complaining billing shows $0 for a bunch of historical days. They want ETA on fix.

tom_sre: action items: 1) quick mitigation: show `estimated` tag in UI for affected orgs so customers know it's partial; 2) backfill job to re-run rollups for affected orgs with correct join cast; 3) patch to normalize keys at ingestion. Also check Kafka topic offsets for the price-service topic in case some messages were lost.

ops-bot: created incident INC-2026-0423 and PagerDuty alert routed to #eng-oncall.

javier: root cause summary from my side: the refactor for multi-price-schemas added a prefix when writing model_price.price_key (`mp:12345`) but the token_ingest pipeline still writes `12345` (no prefix). The LEFT JOIN thus yields NULL for price. Will prepare hotfix to canonicalize keys on read (both sides) + add defensive COALESCE to avoid NaN in sums.

eli_analytics: repro steps I ran locally:
1) checkout release/analytics-rollup v2.0.3
2) run `./scripts/rollup.sh --date 2026-03-15 --org org_99012`
3) observe `p.price_key` values like `mp:12345` while `u.model_price_key` is `12345`
4) try quick SQL patch: `LEFT JOIN model_price p ON concat('mp:', u.model_price_key) = p.price_key` => costs return correctly.

maya_support: can we run that patch as a stopgap in prod while a proper backfill is scheduled? Customers need numbers ASAP.

javier: yes — I'll push v2.0.4 hotfix that normalizes keys on the rollup read path and adds `COALESCE(sum(...), 0)` in the aggregator to prevent NaN. Then we'll kick a backfill job for 13 affected orgs. Planning deploy in 30m.

tom_sre: suggested backfill command for analytics job: `kubectl exec -it rollup-runner -- ./backfill --org org_99012 --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-03-17 --mode replace` — run via batch window and monitor token-costs topic lag. I'll run a dry-run on a single org first.

meera_cs: thanks. Please post ETA when deploy is scheduled so I can update customers.

deploy-bot: started deploy analytics-rollup-service v2.0.4 by javier at 2026-03-17T12:57:02Z

javier: v2.0.4 deployed. Hotfix changes: normalize price keys on read, added defensive coalesce in SQL aggregator, added telemetry flag `price_mismatch_count`.

ops-bot: backfill job queued as job_67321. Running for org_99012 first (dry-run).

eli_analytics: dry-run result: costs now match expected values for org_99012 when using the concat patch. Running full backfill now for 13 orgs. ETA ~ 45 minutes.

maya_support: posted update to customers (emailed the 13 orgs) — said ETA 1h and we flagged UI as "under investigation".

ops-bot: backfill completed for org_99012, job_67321, status: success.

tom_sre: rechecked the dashboard queries — values restored for org_99012 and several others. Running consistency check: compare token totals from pre-rollup parquet vs new rollup for sample windows.

meera_cs: customers on thread reporting numbers restored for org_99012 and org_4471 :tada:. One org still showing NaN (org_8819) — logged as follow-up and included in the next backfill batch.

javier: root-cause final: schema change created a string prefix on price_key in v2.0.3; ingestion produced numeric keys; lack of defensive casting in aggregator produced NaN zeroing. Fix deployed in v2.0.4. Backfill completed for 12/13 orgs; last org queued. Additional follow-ups: add unit test for key canonicalization and add a dashboard alert when price_mismatch_count > 0.

maya_support: closing loop — INC-2026-0423 resolved for majority, follow-up for last org. Will update customers when final backfill completes. :white_check_mark:
